line: Rivers become copper traces as current runs 2,080 km from a dam to a phone charger.
line_cn: 江河变成电路板上的走线，电流从水坝跑 2,080 公里进手机充电器。

camera.move: Ride the pulse (camera locked to a moving head, head on a third)
camera.expresses: following one thing through a system
camera.serves: a delivery route; a signal path; a single order through a process

camera.move: Rise while following (zoom out during the ride until both ends are in frame)
camera.serves: a distance; a supply chain end to end; a timeline
a deadline met; a package delivered; a test result
two numbers side by side; a spec; a rule

camera.move: Matched cut on a centred symbol (same symbol, same screen size, the world around it changes scale)
camera.expresses: the same step repeated at every level

camera.move: Plunge through a hole / via, reverse out of another hole
camera.serves: into a device; into a building; into a file
the big picture after the detail; the system behind one object

transitions: no fades, no wipes, no page turns.
labels: All type is silkscreen in one monoline stroke font routed like traces (0/45/90° strokes, chamfered corners, round caps), drawn in code. Chinese uses the same rules: every hanzi hand-routed on a 0/45/90° grid with the same stroke width as the Latin line beside it. Use simplified characters only and proof every glyph at large size before use.
Text is world-anchored and plotted stroke by stroke; it stays on the board and is still there when the camera pulls back.

Roles: labels (a Chinese line above a smaller English line, same stroke width), board-native text in one language (designators, voltages, timestamps, km, values), micro texture (pinyin tags, notes, REV/sheet lines) which may fade below reading size.

Reading: a label must be fully in frame and stay there for its reading time (≥ 1.5 s + characters at 4.5/s CJK, 15/s Latin). Never let text sit in the depth-of-field bands; never cut text at the frame edge in a held shot. Title caps ≥ 60 px at 1080p.
motion: 30 fps, everything on ones. render(t) depends on t only; motion blur from measured screen motion (180° shutter, sub-frames from 1 to ~20), never across a cut.
Kinds of current, told apart only by how the light moves:
AC / alternating: short dashes rocking back and forth along the trace (a slowed mains frequency) over a faint energised line.
DC / one-way: a continuous lit stream behind a travelling head, with slow streaks inside and an afterglow that dims slowly behind the head.

native_moves.name: Flow becomes current
native_moves.does: A second flow (silver) enters a row of pads; each pad lights on a beat and amber leaves on its other side.
native_moves.fits: raw material entering a factory and leaving as product; requests hitting servers and leaving as responses; donations becoming grants.

native_moves.name: Pulse-path explainer
native_moves.does: Every stage of a process is a component on one trace; the way the light changes (rocking, streaming, thinning) tells what each stage does.
native_moves.fits: a payment's clearing path; a parcel's sorting hubs; a message across a network.

native_moves.name: The map is a board
native_moves.does: Geography re-routed octilinear as copper and channels; rivers, lakes and coasts are clearances with via fences; cities are test points; corridors are buses of parallel traces.
native_moves.fits: a pipeline across countries; a migration route; the cables under an ocean. A board that covers China follows DIRECTOR.md §13.

native_moves.name: Detail callout
native_moves.does: An assembly-drawing circle that shows another place of the same board (or another board) at a chosen scale next to the thing it is compared with.
native_moves.fits: the same mechanism at two sizes; a lab prototype beside the plant; yesterday's version beside today's.

native_moves.name: Nested boards
native_moves.does: A module footprint on a board is a complete board of its own; plunge into it, or pull out through every level in one move.
native_moves.fits: a country → city → building → device; an organisation → team → person; a chip → core → transistor.

native_moves.name: Matched step-down
native_moves.does: The same symbol held centred while the board around it changes scale on each cut.
native_moves.fits: voltage levels; approval tiers; zoom levels of a map.

native_moves.name: Timestamp tags
native_moves.does: Silk frames printing times at two stations, the second tag repeating the first digit-for-digit above its own.
native_moves.fits: latency; a race between two routes; before and after.

score.note: electronic current: arps, clean pluck, bell for each lit pad
